en.html:
This was the end of the corridor.
The way toward the stern lay open. To go toward the bow, I would have to pull open a large door.

There was a door on the right as well.
Now then...?

ja.html:
ここは廊下の終端だ。
　船尾方向には遮るものもなく進めるが、船首方向へ
行くなら大きな扉を引き開けねばならない。

　扉は右側にもある。
　さて……？
